edits.text: PARTIES. This Share Purchase Agreement is between [Seller’s full legal name] as Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. “Shares” means [identify the issuer, class, and number of shares being sold].

1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [to be agreed] (the “Purchase Price”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller, against delivery of the Shares. No deduction, withholding, or setoff shall be permitted except as required by applicable law.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing on a date mutually agreed in writing, subject to receipt of required regulatory approvals and third-party consents. Payment of the Purchase Price and delivery of the Shares shall occur concurrently. Any extension of the closing deadline must be agreed in writing.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Except as disclosed in the disclosure schedules agreed at signing, the Seller represents that the financial statements identified in those schedules fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the issuer as of their respective dates and for their respective periods, in accordance with the accounting principles identified in those schedules, consistently applied, subject, for unaudited statements, to normal year-end adjustments and the absence of footnotes.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations to be agreed in this Agreement, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for actual losses directly resulting from a breach of the Seller’s express representations or covenants in this Agreement. Any indemnity for undisclosed liabilities must be expressly defined and agreed. The parties shall agree a liability cap, basket, survival periods, claim procedures, mitigation requirements, and provisions preventing double recovery before signing.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered text and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential settlement minimum. Remove all non-rendered or concealed content categories before transmission to prevent inadvertent disclosure through material not available for review.

receiver.message_back: For Buyer, please provide Seller’s full legal name, the issuer, class and number of Shares, and supporting financials so we can propose a diligence-supported purchase price; payment and transfer should be concurrent, with Buyer entitled to terminate if required approvals or agreed closing conditions remain unsatisfied at the 30-day deadline. We require title, authority, capitalization, tax and undisclosed-liability warranties, specific disclosure rather than blanket schedule exceptions, and indemnification covering breaches and pre-closing liabilities, with a purchase-price escrow, negotiated caps and survival periods, and appropriate exceptions for fraud, title and authority.

Price remains open pending that process. We propose negotiating any escrow together with the cap, basket and survival periods as a single risk-allocation package, with those terms completed before signing. Please identify any additional closing conditions and provide your proposed economics for that package.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Share Purchase Agreement is between [Seller’s full legal name, jurisdiction and registration details, if applicable] as Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. “Shares” means [number and class of shares] issued by [issuer’s full legal name and jurisdiction]. These particulars must be completed and verified before signing.

1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay USD [to be agreed] (the “Purchase Price”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds against concurrent delivery of the Shares and duly executed transfer instruments. The Purchase Price, less any expressly agreed escrow amount, shall be paid to the account designated by the Seller; any agreed escrow amount shall be deposited concurrently with the agreed escrow agent. No deduction, withholding or setoff shall be permitted except as required by applicable law or expressly provided in this Agreement. Buyer shall give Seller reasonable advance notice of any legally required withholding and provide evidence of timely remittance.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur on a date mutually agreed in writing no later than thirty days after signing, subject to receipt of required regulatory approvals and third-party consents specifically identified in this Agreement and satisfaction or lawful waiver of the other closing conditions expressly agreed before signing. Payment and delivery shall occur concurrently. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to satisfy the conditions within its control. If Closing has not occurred by that deadline, either party may terminate by written notice, unless its own material breach caused the failure to close. Termination shall not affect accrued claims for breach or provisions expressly stated to survive termination. Any extension must be agreed in writing. No financing condition or discretionary diligence condition shall apply unless expressly agreed before signing.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Seller represents at signing and Closing that: (a) Seller owns the Shares free of liens other than restrictions imposed by applicable securities laws and has authority to execute and perform this Agreement; (b) this Agreement constitutes Seller’s binding obligation, subject to customary insolvency and equitable-remedy limitations; (c) the capitalization schedule accurately identifies the issuer’s issued shares and outstanding rights to acquire shares, and the Shares are validly issued and fully paid; (d) the financial statements specifically identified in the disclosure schedules fairly present, in all material respects, the issuer’s financial position and results for the stated dates and periods under the accounting principles identified therein, consistently applied, subject, for unaudited statements, to normal year-end adjustments and absence of footnotes; (e) the issuer has timely filed all material required tax returns, those returns are materially accurate, and all material taxes due have been paid, except amounts contested in good faith and adequately reserved; and (f) the issuer has no material liabilities required to be reflected or reserved under those accounting principles other than liabilities reflected or reserved in the identified financial statements, specifically disclosed in the schedules, or incurred in the ordinary course since the latest balance-sheet date. Disclosure exceptions must identify the relevant warranty and describe the exception with sufficient specificity to disclose its nature and scope. No blanket incorporation of diligence materials shall constitute disclosure. Any additional qualifications and the final disclosure schedules must be agreed before signing.

4. INDEMNITY. Seller shall indemnify Buyer for actual losses arising from breaches of Seller’s express representations or covenants and for pre-Closing liabilities expressly identified as indemnified liabilities in a schedule agreed before signing. There shall be no general indemnity for all pre-Closing liabilities. General warranty claims shall be subject to a deductible basket of USD [to be agreed], an aggregate cap of [to be agreed]% of the Purchase Price and a survival period of [to be agreed] months after Closing. Title and authority claims shall be exempt from the general basket and cap, subject to a separate cap equal to the Purchase Price and a separately agreed survival period. Tax claims shall have a separately agreed survival period. Nothing shall limit liability for Seller’s own fraud or liability that cannot lawfully be limited. Any escrow shall be limited to [to be agreed]% of the Purchase Price, held by an independent agent under agreed release and dispute procedures, and released on an agreed date except for amounts reasonably reserved against timely, specifically notified claims. Escrow shall not increase Seller’s liability limits. Claims must be notified with reasonable particulars before the applicable survival period expires; timely notified claims survive until resolved. Buyer shall reasonably mitigate losses, permit Seller to participate in defending third-party claims under agreed procedures, and receive no double recovery, including for amounts already reflected in the Purchase Price or actually recovered from insurance or third parties, net of reasonable recovery costs. All bracketed terms, indemnified-liability schedules and claim procedures must be completed before signing.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential settlement minimum. No hidden content is identified for removal.

receiver.message_back: Subject to verified seller/share particulars, satisfactory confidential diligence and agreement on price before signing, Buyer proposes a 15% escrow for 24 months, a 30% general-warranty cap, a 0.5% deductible basket and 24-month survival; title, authority, capitalization and pre-Closing tax claims should fall outside that basket and general cap, be capped at the Purchase Price and survive until 60 days after the applicable limitation period, with fraud and non-limitable liability uncapped and escrow not the exclusive remedy. Additional closing conditions should include materially accurate warranties (fundamental warranties accurate in all respects), material covenant compliance, no material adverse change or restraining order, all required approvals and consents specifically scheduled before signing, release of share liens, and delivery of transfer instruments, updated registers and agreed officer certificates; Buyer also requires an indemnity for pre-Closing taxes and specifically identified diligence risks, with defense and settlement procedures protecting Buyer against admissions or nonmonetary obligations without its consent.
